description: Fernwärme Versorgungsgebiete Thüringen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoproxy.geoportal-th.de. District heating is the commercial supply of heat from a heat generation plant not owned by the building owner (§2 (3) FFVAV). The dataset contains the district heating supply areas with further information on the relevant responsible bodies. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "District heating supply areas Thuringia" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Versorgungsgebiet, Thüringen, opendata, Fernwärme, ENER, ENVI. The listing shows 2025-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
